# Psalm 5 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the choirmaster. For the flutes. A psalm of David.

**2** Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.

**3** Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.

**4** O LORD, in the morning You hear my voice; in the morning I prepare my prayer before You and watch.

**5** For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; evil may not dwell with You.

**6** The boastful shall not stand before Your eyes; You hate all evildoers.

**7** You destroy those who speak lies; the LORD abhors the man of blood and deceit.

**8** But I, through the abundance of Your steadfast love, will enter Your house. I will bow down toward Your holy temple in the fear of You.

**9** Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make Your way straight before me.

**10** For there is no truth in their mouth; their inmost being is destruction. Their throat is an open grave; they flatter with their tongue.

**11** Make them bear their guilt, O God; let them fall by their own counsels. Because of the abundance of their transgressions, cast them out, for they have rebelled against You.

**12** But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever sing for joy. Spread Your protection over them, that those who love Your name may exult in You.

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

- **5:5-7**: A six-fold description of those God opposes: wickedness, evil, boastfulness, iniquity, falsehood, bloodshed. The list is comprehensive.

- **5:8**: 'Steadfast love' (hesed) — the key relational term of the Psalter. It is covenantal loyalty, not mere emotion.

— LOGOS
